sources.title: TCCC Guidelines 25 January2024
confirmed: OTFC800µg for casualties not in shock/respiratory distress; reassess15min; finger/uniform attachment recommended
limits: User specifies650mg×2 ER: retained as user design; differs from this2024 document
Timing compression, all self-administration, prefilled50mg syringe and body/screen gains are game allowances/tuning
Absence of opioid respiratory suppression with low-dose ketamine is a game policy, not a claim of zero clinical risk

sources.title: Battlefield Analgesia in TCCC (PMID28601204)
confirmed: CWMP / OTFC for patients without shock / ketamine for shock or respiratory distress
limits: Does not quantify our shock adverse-effect multiplier, onset compression, or duration curve

sources.title: US DailyMed oral transmucosal fentanyl citrate label
confirmed: Lozenge consumed over15min; approximately2g sugar per unit; serious respiratory depression and hypotension described
limits: Label describes opioid-tolerant cancer breakthrough pain; not a tactical self-treatment protocol
Game durations120/150min are tuning; no qualified1–2h analgesia duration confirmed from this label
10g including packaging/handle is tuning, not sourced packaged mass

sources.title: Pfizer Ketamine Hydrochloride Injection US label
confirmed: Transient increases in BP/heart rate/cardiac index; emergence reactions; respiratory depression/apnea possible with overdose/rapid use
limits: Anesthetic doses/onset cannot be transferred to50mg IM analgesia; game30–40min duration and onset compression tuned

sources.title: Chest seals evidence review PMID33721314
confirmed: Four swine-model studies: vented seals more successful in preventing tension than unvented; frequent reassessment still needed
limits: Animal model; does not measure a0.006/s human pneumothorax recovery rate

sources.title: Vented chest seal efficacy in swine HPTX PMID28422911
confirmed: 26pigs,43kg; open chest+226mL blood; incremental air infusion; valve performance differs with bleeding
limits: Artificial communicating injury; not clinical incidence or our numeric venting coefficient

sources.title: Vienna penetrating chest injury series PMID37544864
confirmed: 480penetrating chest injuries; severe subset43%; combined (tension-)pneumothorax29% within severe subset
limits: Combined pneumothorax/tension endpoint and mostly stabbing: cannot use29% as a tension incidence target for rifle lung wounds

sources.title: Chest trauma catheter series PMID15191471
confirmed: 173patients/211tubes; tension was7.5% of insertion indications;90.2% blunt injury
limits: Selection bias, mixed injury and different denominator; not penetrating lung-wound incidence

sources.title: Fatal police penetrating-torso series PMID22591934
limits: Fatal-only cohort/retrospective autopsy and underrecognition; not a valid0% gameplay target

unconfirmed: Qualified penetrating pulmonary-wound tension incidence: no valid exact target found; deterministic10% valve trait is explicit tuning, measured13/120 conditional cases, not clinical incidence
Actual packaged masses of new pill/OTFC/prefilled syringe/blood kit/medic pouch were not found: all envelopes/masses tuned

Pressure-bag500mL/10min, real oral onset30–60min, OTFC15min clinical onset and50mgIM5min analgesic onset were not independently confirmed; timing policies follow user design with actual-label limits stated
